The controller is clearly treating `group.save` as the success gate for the whole operation, but the diff does not show what `Group#add` does (whether it immediately persists the join row or just mutates in-memory state). So the claimed “already-added members remain in DB even if save fails” is a plausible atomicity concern but not strictly verifiable from this diff alone.
